chapters.chapter_title: I Have Fried Chicken for Breakfast

questions.text: Which food does Tari have for dinner?
questions.discussion: The dinner row shows noodles and water. Noodles are the food.

image.alt: Tari's meal card. Breakfast: eggs and milk. Lunch: rice and fish. Dinner: noodles and water.

questions.text: What do both children have for lunch?
questions.discussion: Rice appears on both lunch trays.

image.alt: Two lunch trays. Ayu: rice, soup, water. Dito: rice, fish, milk.

questions.text: Which sentence matches Beni's lunch drink?
options: Beni drinks orange juice at lunch.
Beni drinks orange juice at dinner.
questions.answer: Beni drinks orange juice at lunch.
questions.discussion: The Lunch row lists orange juice.

image.alt: Beni's drink chart. Breakfast: milk. Lunch: orange juice. Dinner: water.

questions.text: Which question should the group ask to complete Sasa's card?
options: What do you have for breakfast?
What do you have for lunch?
What do you have for dinner?
questions.answer: What do you have for dinner?
questions.discussion: Only the dinner row has no entry.

image.alt: Sasa's survey card. Breakfast: bread. Lunch: soup. Dinner: (no entry).

questions.text: What is the same on the two cards?
questions.discussion: Both cards list tea, but they show different foods.

image.alt: Two breakfast cards. Ina: eggs and tea. Bayu: bread and tea.

questions.discussion: The plan puts fried rice at midday, which is lunchtime.

image.alt: Lani's plan for the day. Morning: bread. Midday: fried rice. Evening: soup.

questions.text: Which card shows Adi's first meal of the day?
questions.discussion: Card B is marked breakfast, the first meal of the day.

image.alt: Adi's meal cards. Card A: dinner, fish. Card B: breakfast, eggs. Card C: lunch, noodles.

questions.text: What changes from Monday to Tuesday?
questions.discussion: Both entries list rice. Fish appears on Monday and eggs appear on Tuesday.

image.alt: Maya's lunch notes. Monday: rice and fish. Tuesday: rice and eggs.

questions.text: Who has soup and milk for lunch?
questions.discussion: Putri's row is the only one that lists both soup and milk.

image.alt: Lunch survey. Hana: soup and water. Iwan: rice and milk. Putri: soup and milk.

questions.text: Which report matches the meal Riko has at school?
questions.discussion: The school entry is in the lunch row and lists rice.

image.alt: Riko's meal record. Breakfast: home, bread. Lunch: school, rice. Dinner: home, soup.
